situational_context: Running comeback at 136 days (36 runs since May 3, 2026). Post-cold recovery: gros rhume (severity 6/10, Sep 8-15) resolved yesterday. C4 block #21-40 expired Sep 13 — archived; new block TBD. Weight milestone: 99.68 kg (first time below 100 kg). ACWR 1.06 (safe band). On conges through Sep 25 — full training availability. MEDICATION: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg weekly since Aug 12 (day 35). Teleconsultation Sep 15 confirmed: dose stays at 0.25 mg through 2nd pen (last dose Sep 23), step to 0.5 mg expected Sep 30 (prescriber decision, not label default). RHR 53.3 bpm (+4 vs pre-initiation 49.3 — expected class effect, no second signal); HRV weekly avg 32 (post-initiation range 30-34, expected). Nutrition logging gap now 25+ consecutive zero-intake days (since Aug 23): on GLP-1 this is the dominant risk — protein floor and energy availability unverifiable. Gravel return Sep 15 (22.5 km, load 36, first ride in 122 days) well-tolerated.

recommendations.text: Resume nutrition logging immediately. 25+ consecutive zero-intake days on a GLP-1 agonist (appetite suppressed by design) during an active running comeback is the highest-risk scenario for low energy availability and lean-mass loss. Protein target >=160g/day (1.6g/kg at 99.7 kg) is unverifiable without logging. Even rough daily logs (photo + estimate) are better than silence.
